query:
SELECT
            (EXTRACT(epoch FROM recorded)::int / $1) * $1 as time,
            project_id as id,
            COUNT(*) as total
        FROM analytics_views
        WHERE recorded BETWEEN $2 AND $3
            AND project_id = ANY($4)
        GROUP BY (EXTRACT(epoch FROM recorded)::int / $1), project_id
        ORDER BY time, project_id
